subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): add vendor-neutral session attribute option for OTel session grouping

question: Should OTel session grouping end when OpenClaw rotates `sessionId`, or intentionally remain stable for the lifetime of the routing `sessionKey` across resets?
rationale: Both choices are implementable, but they create materially different conversation boundaries and privacy guarantees that cannot be inferred safely from the existing redaction policy.

options.title: Use reset-scoped identity
options.body: Hash the active `sessionId` so `/new`, `/reset`, daily reset, and idle expiry start a new telemetry grouping while retaining opt-in pseudonymization.

options.title: Approve routing-bucket correlation
options.body: Keep hashing `sessionKey`, but explicitly document that the exported identifier links conversations across reset boundaries and require corresponding retention approval.

options.title: Keep redaction only
options.body: Decline the new config surface if no owner wants to establish and support a stable session-correlation privacy contract.

recommendation.title: Use reset-scoped identity
recommendation.body: Hash the active `sessionId` so `/new`, `/reset`, daily reset, and idle expiry start a new telemetry grouping while retaining opt-in pseudonymization.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the documented session lifecycle, public configuration policy, and diagnostics privacy boundary.
